recipe.name: Barbecued Oysters
directions: Set up your grill for direct grilling and preheat to medium.

Meanwhile, shuck the oysters using a shucking knife, taking care not to spill the juices. Discard the top shell and arrange the oysters in the shellfish rack. Top each with 2 teaspoons barbecue sauce, grated cheese, a sprinkle of barbecue rub, and a splash of hot sauce (if using).
Place the rack with the oysters on the grill and lower the grill lid. Grill the oysters until just cooked and the cheese and sauce are melted and bubbling, 3 to 5 minutes.

ingredients.name: Your Favorite Barbecue Sauce
ingredients.notes: I’m partial to Best of Barbecue Chipotle Molasses Barbecue Sauce

ingredients.name: Your Favorite Barbecue Rub
ingredients.notes: I’m partial to Best of Barbecue All-Purpose Rub

ingredients.name: A Splash of Your Favorite Hot Sauce (optional)
